newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GSM shareholders okay Ashanti merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GSM shareholders okay Ashanti merger.

text.p: Shareholders in Golden Shamrock Mines Ltd on Monday voted in favour of a merger with Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd.
Shareholders also voted in favour a reduction in the company's capital shares from 235 million to 10 million, which represents Ashanti's holding in Golden Shamrock.
The companies would seek court approval for the merger on October 18 with Golden Shamrock shares expected to cease trading on October 22.

GSM and Ashanti announced a merger plan in April under which GSM shareholders were to be offered one Ashanti share for every 22.5 GSM shares plus bonus participation in future gold discoveries at GSM's Siguiri gold project in Guinea, West Africa.
Ashanti has said it plans to dispose of GSM's Australian assets when the merger is completed.
Rothschild Australia, which prepared a report on the merger, has said the market value of these assets is about A$80 million. GSM shares were steady at 95 cents at 12.30 p.m. (0230 GMT).
